nodes.nie.text.t: "I understand." The runner closes his eyes. "Nobody wants another man's death in his pocket."

nodes.s.text.t: In the ditch lies a young runner in a red cloak, with a bandage across half his face. "Jarogniew. Army post. I've a letter that mustn't reach the ones who shot me. Hide it in the oak in Marchwood. Whoever finds it will pay." He presses a wax-sealed letter into your hand.

nodes.zgoda.text.t: Jarogniew sinks back onto the grass, relieved. "The oak with the hollow, on the south side. Don't read it. I know you want to."
